command: Implement two fixed wrappers. First, aha_tensor_stream_endpoint must accept channel-0 512-bit beats, preserve tag/tensor_id/last/format, feed each beat to the existing aha_garnet_proc_packet_writer as eight ordered 64-bit proc_packet writes, and assert the native 1-bit EOS only after packet_done for the final beat; its reverse packer must combine eight ordered 64-bit proc read words into one channel-1 beat. Second, kv_tensor_stream_endpoint must map channel-2 writes and channel-3 reads to 512 KiB KV staging as 512-bit beats with byte enables and stable sideband. Connect both wrappers to matrix_direct_streams and test randomized backpressure before composing the L3 top.
success_condition: At least 100000 mixed endpoint transfers have exact data, byte enable, tag, tensor_id, last and format; every AHA beat produces exactly eight ordered proc writes, EOS never precedes acceptance of the final chunk, KV read-after-write is byte exact, all four channels progress under randomized backpressure, zero loss/duplication/reorder/protocol error/timeout, and Verilator -Wall is clean.
failure_policy: Do not reinterpret the 4x16 Gaussian baseline as the final 4x4 SFU, invent an AHA bank address mapping, drop Tensor Stream sideband, emit EOS from stream valid rather than final proc-packet completion, bypass the KV staging interface, weaken the 100000-transfer gate, or mark L3 PASS before combined command/event/fabric/stream closure.
